import_operational_preconditions: Privileged writers (service_role/postgres/admin tooling, repair-apply routines run by an operator) can set selected_sporely_taxon_id without the RPC's active-release validation. A privileged write that commits before the cutover is caught by the post-activation selection check (the import aborts); one queued behind the cutover locks resumes after commit and is not validated. Precondition: pause admin tooling, repair jobs and any service-role scripts that write observations or taxonomy-v3 tables during the import window.
Run in a quiet window: during the ~3 s cutover, search and writes to observations/reference tables wait (lock_timeout 10 s on the import side; clients may see a short stall).
Immediately before: refresh the read-only reference check, verify the production target (system identifier 7606130613603586966) and that public.sporely_local_rehearsal_marker is absent.
Requires release_approved for -11, regeneration of the production SQL and a diff against the rehearsal SQL, and a separate explicit approval to run it.
